description: Reads a Shopify store's public products.json and reports what would break a Google Merchant Center or Meta catalogue feed: missing barcodes, absent weights, unpriced or unavailable variants, and thin descriptions. Shopify-only, because products.json is a Shopify endpoint.

limit.description: How many products to sample, 1 to 250. Default 250.

url.description: The Shopify store domain, for example example.com.

name: audit_product_feed
title: Audit a Shopify catalogue for feed readiness
